dialogues.speaker: Houallet
dialogues.text: Trust me, your story will be a thing of honor in Fontaine — indeed, in all of Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Volonte Nouvelle
dialogues.text: Really, it wasn't all that complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Houallet
dialogues.text: No need to be so modest, good sir!

dialogues.speaker: Houallet
dialogues.text: Would any less dramatic a tale be worthy of your title, "Monsieur"?

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Volonte Nouvelle
dialogues.text: Well, then I can only repeat the statement I gave the Maison Gardiennage...

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Volonte Nouvelle
dialogues.text: That day, I saw someone run past, followed by a cry of "someone catch that thief"!

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Volonte Nouvelle
dialogues.text: So I grabbed the crowbar next to me and swept it outward...

dialogues.speaker: Houallet
dialogues.text: Yes, of course, I've written all that down. But was there anything else...?
